title: Image models get a listing endpoint
summary:
A new image-model listing endpoint and API reference landed alongside a model-registry fix, tighter image queues and more precise usage tracking.

Added `/api/generate/image/models` alongside an API reference and OpenAPI schema covering generation requests, image parameters, model listings and structured errors.

Enter’s text-model registry now includes `gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07`, addressing requests that failed because the model ID was absent.

Seedream now requires the Flower tier, and Kontext was removed from the available image models. Nanobanana and Seedream have longer queue intervals and lower Flower and Nectar concurrency caps; authenticated requests from the same IP share a queue. Prompt enhancement now returns the original prompt without rewriting it.

highlights.title: List image models
highlights.text: Use `/api/generate/image/models` to retrieve the available image models programmatically.
